name: Stirling PDF
description: Merge, split, convert and edit PDFs — all on your server.
compose:
services:
  stirling-pdf:
    image: stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:latest
    container_name: stirling-pdf
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:8080"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/data:/usr/share/tessdata
